LightningComponentBundle.description: Renders a picklist field filtered to the values allowed for a specific record type. Designed for use in Flow Screens and Record Pages.

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: Object API Name
property.description: API name of the Salesforce object (e.g. Case, WorkOrder, Account).

property.name: recordTypeName
property.label: Record Type (Developer Name or ID)
property.description: Developer name (e.g. SDO_Service_Case) or 15/18-character Salesforce ID of the record type to filter picklist values by. Leave blank to use the Master record type (all values).

property.name: fieldApiName
property.label: Picklist Field API Name
property.description: API name of the picklist field to render (e.g. Status, Priority, SLA_Type__c).

property.name: placeholder
property.label: Placeholder Text
property.description: Text shown inside the combobox when no value is selected.

property.name: includeNone
property.label: Include None Option
property.description: When enabled, a '--None--' entry is added at the top of the list.

property.name: required
property.label: Required
property.description: Marks the picklist as a required field.

property.name: value
property.label: Selected Value
property.description: The picklist value selected by the user. Use as a Flow output variable to pass the selection to the next flow element.
